At CQ, we bring you the classics of French dining - unpretentious, brilliantly prepared, and always offering incredible value. From our perfectly seared Steak Frites to our indulgent Pain Perdu, every dish is crafted with passion, blending sophistication with accessibility. We are your neighborhood brasserie. Bienvenue à CQ French Brasserie - a brasserie for friends & family.
